GrEnFIn, hosted at the University of Bologna, trains sustainable-energy experts who can bridge finance, physics and energy-transition technologies. The 2027-2029 call opened on 14 October 2026 and closes on 7 January 2027 at 11:00 CET — note the unusual morning cut-off.

Programme Highlights

  • University of Bologna-coordinated programme at the finance-energy intersection
  • Deadline of 7 January 2027 falls at 11:00 CET, not midnight
  • Scholarship of EUR 1,400 monthly for selected students
  • Results expected on 26 February 2027 for a September 2027 start

Who Should Apply

Economics, finance, engineering and physics graduates interested in sustainable energy markets and green finance are the target cohort; quantitative skills are key.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarship of EUR 1,400 per month for selected students, with participation costs covered.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the University of Bologna portal linked on the GrEnFIn site before the 11:00 CET cut-off on 7 January 2027. Key deadline information: 7 January 2027 (11:00 CET); call opened 14 October 2026 for the 2027-2029 edition.

Official Source

  • Official application page (verified link)

About GrEnFIn Consortium (University of Bologna)

The GrEnFIn consortium is coordinated by the University of Bologna and delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Greening Energy Market and Finance with European partners in the energy and finance space.

Official website: https://site.unibo.it/grenfin-emjm/en

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 7 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
